description:
Session ended 2026-08-11 ~10:00 SGT with work left uncommitted. This bead is the resume point. Nine commits were pushed to develop, ending at a9f71f01.

WHAT IS COMMITTED AND PUSHED (safe, verified):
734a5307 23-group Tobias decay heat + HTR-10 KTA/ZBS module
89100a93 DWSIM flowsheet/dynamics/column/petroleum/clean-energy port (~45k lines, 650 tests)

c5422e8d CLAUDE.md: TUAS natural-circ tests run in parallel
a9f71f01 chem-eng relicense to GPL-3.0 + O(1) recurrences + Octave z-domain

UNCOMMITTED, COMPLETE, BLOCKED ONLY BY A BUILD BREAK ELSEWHERE:
- docs/reactor-scoping/htr10-neutronics.md (966 lines) — the multifidelity pipeline scoping document
- crates/outram-park-digital-twin-engine/src/htr10/neutronics.rs (~1150 lines) — B1-B4 benchmark spec as typed uom data, 45 published values each with a LiteratureSource and AccessTier
- crates/outram-mc-libs/examples/htr10_fuel_zone_kinf.rs — the rung-1 MC calculation
- modifications to htr10/mod.rs and design.rs
Its agent reported 11/11 tests passing and Android clean. I could NOT independently re-verify because the digital-twin-engine build was broken by an in-flight edit in a dependency (see below). TO LAND: fix the break, run cargo test --release -p outram-park-digital-twin-engine --lib, then commit.

UNCOMMITTED AND INCOMPLETE — TWO AGENTS WERE STILL MID-EDIT WHEN THE SESSION ENDED. THE TREE DOES NOT COMPILE:
1. crates/tampines/ and crates/tuas_boussinesq_solver/ — the pebble-bed conduction agent. tampines/src/lib.rs declares mod pebble_bed; and pebble_bed/mod.rs declares cht, feedback, kta, pebble, triso — some of those files may not exist. Adding NuclearGraphiteMatrixA3 and NuclearGraphiteIG110 to SolidMaterial left non-exhaustive matches in solid_material_surface_roughness.rs, specific_heat_capacity.rs, temperature_from_specific_enthalpy.rs and enthalpy_data.rs. It was also mid-way through replacing the hard-coded HYBRID_RHO_TAPER_LO/HI density window in outram-park-fork-coolprop with a (p,h) window.
2. crates/njoy-outram-park-fork/ — the S(alpha,beta) agent. CoherentElastic was being refactored from s_of_e/temperature_k to temperatures_k/s_tables/temp_interp; call sites in mf7.rs, coherent.rs, thermal.rs and endout.rs may be unmigrated.

Both were sent wrap-up instructions to leave the tree compiling; whether they completed is unknown. FIRST ACTION NEXT SESSION: run cargo check --workspace --lib --tests and see what is actually broken. If a refactor is half-done, reverting it cleanly is better than leaving it — a working 296 K-only thermal scattering implementation beats a broken migration.

REMEMBER: nothing was committed from those two crates, so git checkout of the affected files is always available as a clean escape.

notes.content:
SESSION-END SWEEP COMPLETED 2026-08-11 ~10:15 SGT. This supersedes the pessimistic build assessment in the original description above.

BUILD STATE IS CLEAN, VERIFIED NOT ASSUMED:
  cargo check --workspace --lib --tests   -> 0 errors
  cargo check --workspace --all-targets   -> 0 errors (examples and benches included, which the Android rule requires)
  git status                              -> working tree clean, everything committed
Both agents that were mid-edit when the session ended (njoy S(alpha,beta), and the pebble-bed agent which was KILLED mid-write) left self-consistent trees. The njoy CoherentElastic migration had in fact completed before the wrap-up message reached it. The pebble-bed agent's mod.rs declares only the module that exists.

Test suites verified at session end: njoy 393 passed, coolprop 260 passed, digital-twin-engine 204 passed, chem-eng 32 passed, dwsim-libs 659 passed, kovan-literature 69 passed, tampines 4 passed. Zero failures anywhere.

THE ONE REAL GAP THE SWEEP FOUND, now filed: the pebble-bed agent was killed before it could write tests or file its own handoff. Two beads created to cover that:
- op-jyyp.16 — pebble_bed/zbs.rs is 317 lines with ZERO tests. It is a real implementation (no todo!()) but has never been checked against the 18-point reference table that was its whole acceptance criterion. The oracle already exists read-only at digital-twin-engine/src/htr10/zbs.rs.
- op-jyyp.17 — the remaining three conduction scales (TRISO, pebble, CHT) plus the graphite feedback channel, with what landed and what did not recorded precisely.

Also still open from the session: op-wxzp (the TUAS natural-circulation gate, run ~70 min and killed — neither pass nor fail).

Final state: eleven commits pushed to develop, ending at 4feb6c84. A one-shot resume trigger was set for 12:07 today, but it is SESSION-ONLY and dies with the Claude session — this bead is the durable record, so nothing is lost if it does not fire.

title: HANDOFF 2026-08-11: uncommitted work in the tree, and how to land it
